snippet.title: Teeny Quests Preview
snippet.description:
Teeny Quests is a browser-based adventure puzzle game with a real focus on the level editor. You will be able to sign in and create your own levels or even whole games in this SVG-driven engine. I plan to put up some code review videos when it's closer to completion, so if you're into bending Angular to your will and like to make games to refine your skills, stick around.

(The music is just some Garage Band nonsense.)
